# Hi there, I'm Thanh

I'm a robotics engineer and researcher passionate about **robot manipulation**, **robot system identification**, **reinforcement learning**, and **simulation-to-real transfer**. I build tools and frameworks that help bridge the gap between robot models and real hardware.

---

## What I'm working on

- Robot system identification frameworks for manipulators and humanoids
- Reinforcement learning for locomotion and manipulation in MuJoCo
- End-to-end manipulation pipelines for low-cost robot arms
- Long-horizon task and motion planning (TAMP) for manipulation
